Basket Boat Tour & Kayak Tour (Dynasty Phu Quoc) is the kind of activity most visitors scroll past, but the 4.8★ rating from 379 reviews tells the real story. You paddle a round woven boat, you wobble, you laugh, you get it. No script. Just water and motion.

Kayak options available too if you want to cover more ground.

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
